The DATA lever is CONFIRMED twice (tn200->400 +0.0165; tn400->460 +0.0078) PROVIDED exposure is not sacrificed too far. (2) LIMITER = the EPOCHS-vs-DATA tradeoff at the 1200s budget. iter-7 (tn460/ep9) already lands at 1139s, so ep9 cannot be held above tn460 (tn480/ep9 = 1225s busts the wall). The ONLY untried point that reaches FULL 579 coverage is to trade exposure DOWN -- but iter-6 showed 6x is too low. The clean test: FULL data at the HIGHEST affordable exposure 7x (>iter-6 6x). (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 460 -> 579 (full pool), epochs 9 -> 7. grad_steps 4053 > iter-6 3474; exposure 7x > iter-6 6x; coverage 100pct > iter-7 79pct. This DOMINATES iter-6 on every axis and tests whether the last 119 slices help at the max exposure the wall permits. (4) HYPOTHESIS: filling the LAST 21pct of the train pool (tn460 -> 579, full coverage) at 7x exposure lifts hr ABOVE the iter-7 best 0.336607, because the DATA lever is itnet_v3 strongest confirmed axis and iter-6 6x merely UNDER-trained (ep6 clearly too few -- epochs plateaued only at ep18 on tn200) while 7x is closer to the proven ~9x basin. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.336607 at tn579/ep7, the last 21pct of data does not help at 7x -- itnet_v3 needs >=8-9x exposure that full data cannot afford inside the wall, so its budget-constrained ceiling is the tn460/ep9 point hr 0.337 -> file the ceiling, stays #5. (5) BUDGET (HARD 1200s = train+score): from iter-7 actual (tn460/ep9 -> 1139.1s) recalibrated per_slice = (1139.1-481)/(9*460) = 0.1590 s/slice, fixed 481s. tn579/ep7 = 481 + 7*579*0.1590 = 1125s = 18.8 min < 1200s (conservative 0.1723 s/slice fit gives 1179s = 19.7min, STILL inside). epochs=8 would be 1217-1279s -> BUSTS the wall, so ep7 is the max integer that fits at full data. Train-only at ep7 = 7*579*0.1590 = 644s < max_train_s=720 backstop, so it never truncates (checks between epochs; fences only runaway slowdown); the 214-slice per-sample val + figure always land inside the 30-min sbatch wall. lr HELD at 1e-4 (v3 is lr-FRAGILE: lr3e-4 collapsed in prior probes -- do NOT touch). val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside dc_step overflows otherwise). HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP init + per-sample itnet.projector swap for the k=3 DC steps, bg_target=truth. (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign. Predicted iter-8 hr: 0.34-0.35 if full-coverage-at-7x helps; <=0.3366 falsifies -> budget-constrained ceiling at ~0.337 (tn460/ep9), stays #5.
